headline: Bitcoin bounced back to about $58,000 on Saturday after falling as low as $55,130, its lowest price since September 2024, while money kept leaving US bitcoin funds.

market.asOf: Read by this desk from CoinMarketCap: bitcoin and solana at about 11:56-11:58 UTC Sat 21 Nov (18:56-18:58 Bangkok), ether re-read at about 12:15 UTC (19:15 Bangkok). Prices move fast; use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: This desk could not open a Fear & Greed index page this run. Cryptonews.net reported the Fear & Greed index at 6 out of 100 on Saturday, one point above the 6 February low of 5.

stories.title: Bitcoin bounces to about $58,000 after its lowest price since September 2024
stories.summary: Bitcoin dropped under $56,000 early Saturday, breaking below its summer low, then climbed back to around $58,000 by mid-morning UTC. The bounce is small next to the fall: traders who borrowed to bet on higher prices were forced out in large numbers, and fear readings are near record lows.
points: Bitcoin hit a low of $55,130 on Binance in the 06:00 UTC hour, then recovered as high as $58,672.05, per Blockchain Reporter.

Reuters, via Investing.com, had bitcoin down 9.89% at $55,789.1 and ether down 10.12% at $1,564.14 at 05:56 GMT; trading firm Wintermute says bitcoin needs to win back $68,000 for a convincing recovery.
About $2.40 billion of crypto futures bets were wiped out in 24 hours, more than $1 billion of them on bitcoin and $545 million on ether, per CoinGlass data cited by CoinDesk.
Bitcoin is down 28% this quarter, per CoinDesk.

sources.label: CoinDesk: bitcoin at a two-year low

stories.title: US bitcoin funds lose about $1.25 billion in a week
stories.summary: Money kept flowing out of US spot bitcoin ETFs, the funds that let people buy bitcoin through a normal brokerage account. Friday's figures are still incomplete, but the week was clearly negative for both bitcoin and ether funds.
points: Bitcoin ETFs lost about $1.25 billion over 16-20 Nov and ether ETFs about $221.7 million, per crypto.news using Farside data.
Friday's posted total was -$124.5 million with BlackRock's IBIT not yet reported, so it may change, per crypto.news.
On Thursday 19 Nov bitcoin ETFs lost $582.2 million, $541.1 million of it from BlackRock's IBIT, and November's outflows reached about $3.47 billion, per The Block.
US spot ether ETFs lost $131.2 million on Thursday, per The Block.

stories.title: AI stock rout and Fed hike fears hit crypto company shares
stories.summary: Friday's sell-off in AI and chip stocks spread to crypto-related shares, while traders bet the Fed will raise interest rates in December. US stock markets are closed for the weekend, so these are Friday's closing numbers.
points: Nvidia fell 14.01% on Friday; the Nasdaq-100 fund QQQ fell 5.67%, the S&P 500 fund SPY 3.64% and the Dow fund DIA 1.98%, per StockTitan.
Strategy (MSTR) closed at $77.80, down about 30% from $111.62 a week earlier; Coinbase closed at $101.97 and Robinhood at $62.17, each about 20% lower on the week, per Bitcoin.com News.
Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on 18 Nov: "My view is then you have to go 50 in December," meaning a half-point rate rise, per Decrypt.
Reuters reported CME FedWatch odds of about 99% for a quarter-point December hike on Friday 20 Nov, per FinanceFeeds.

briefs.title: OKX and ICE tokenized-stock venue opens to US users on Monday
briefs.summary: OKXICE says it will launch on 23 Nov with 70 assets confirmed by issuers, under the SEC's innovation exemption, per The Block.

briefs.title: CFTC chair on how Hyperliquid could serve US users
briefs.summary: CFTC Chair Selig said decentralised venues will "have to come in and partner with an exchange or obtain your own exchange," per The Block.

briefs.title: Zcash leads altcoin losses
briefs.summary: Zcash fell 20.22% in 24 hours to around $689, per Cryptonews.net.

briefs.title: Twenty One Capital keeps buying bitcoin
briefs.summary: Twenty One Capital bought 154.32 BTC at an average of $64,801.01, bringing its holdings to 43,668 BTC, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: JPMorgan: bitcoin trades far below its mining cost
briefs.summary: JPMorgan estimates it costs about $86,000 to produce one bitcoin and says "some capital has also left the crypto market altogether," per The Block.

Q3 GDP is expected at 3.5% against the 3.4% first estimate, per Trading Economics. Durable goods forecast +0.5% (prior +1.9%), per Trading Economics. On Friday 27 Nov US stocks close early at 1:00pm ET (01:00 Sat Bangkok), per NYSE. Crypto trades all day, but thin trading can mean bigger swings.

calendar.event: Next Fed meeting and rate decision
calendar.note: Two-day meeting 8-9 Dec with a press conference at 2:30pm ET Wed 9 Dec (02:30 Thu Bangkok), per the Fed's December calendar. The current range is 3.75-4.00%, per Decrypt. Markets expect a hike; see the stock story above for the odds.
